svg.title: Step 5: a root token for one planned change
svg.desc: Two step tags read left to right: 1 Sign in as admin, in the upper left, and 2 Approve with passkey, above the phone. The admin holds a phone whose screen asks Approve this change, with a fingerprint and a green tick, and touches it with a thumb. The phone shows no ticket and has no box. Next to it a laptop on a desk shows a QR code, labelled scan to approve. A teal arrow arcs from the phone, clear above the laptop, to a small gear, the executor, on the machine side, labelled only for this change. The machine's safe door carries a green open padlock. At the gear, a small root token ticket is crossed out at once, labelled Root token: used once, gone. The gear makes one green short-lived ticket with a clock, labelled Narrow token: one change, and a second, faded ticket is crossed out, labelled Used up.
